articles.title: Ancient DNA Reveals Medieval Graves Weren't Family Burials
articles.summary: DNA from 142 Viking Age and medieval Swedes shows most people buried together weren't relatives. One woman, Lady 56, was buried with a shell linked to a 2,000-km pilgrimage to Spain.

articles.title: CERN Begins Dismantling the Large Hadron Collider for a Major Upgrade
articles.summary: CERN has started removing 28 superconducting magnets from the Large Hadron Collider. The new magnets will be 40% stronger, boosting collision rates and giving scientists more data.

articles.title: Webb Telescope Releases One of Its Largest Images, Revealing Record-Breaking Brown Dwarfs
articles.summary: The James Webb Space Telescope released one of its biggest images ever: IC 348, a star-forming nebula 1,000 light-years away. It contains the least massive brown dwarfs ever found.
